solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Communicate with bishop over satisfactory primer

parts.note: to text someone is to communicate with them by phone message
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
O is the cricket scoring abbreviation for an over
OK means satisfactory, all right

explanation.surface: Someone contacts a bishop about a decent introductory book for the parish.
explanation.definitionFit: A primer is an elementary instruction book, the kind of standard volume a pupil studies from.

clue.text: Maybe Chinese festival involving English sailors

indicators.note: involving means the festival's word wraps round the other letters

parts.note: Easter is the Christian spring festival
RN, the Royal Navy, stands for sailors

explanation.surface: A Chinese festival seems to feature some English sailors on shore leave.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from the East, such as a person from China, is an example of an easterner; 'Maybe' marks the example.

clue.text: Empress's army once carrying nerve gas

definitions.note: read as 'Empress is', the 's serving as the link

indicators.note: carrying means the army's letters hold the gas inside them

parts.note: TA, the Territorial Army, is the old name of Britain's reserve army, hence 'once'
sarin is a nerve gas

explanation.surface: An empress's former army transports a deadly nerve agent.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Empress's' stands for 'is', joining the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A tsarina was the wife of a Russian tsar or a female Russian ruler, an empress of Russia.

clue.text: It thus set up a Roman port

indicators.note: in a down clue, set up means the letters are turned to read upwards

parts.note: so means thus, in this way

explanation.surface: A cryptic instruction about establishing a harbour city for Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: Ostia was the harbour city at the mouth of the Tiber that served ancient Rome.

clue.text: Aegean island some seek ostentatiously

indicators.note: some means only part of the following words is taken, the letters run across them

explanation.surface: Some showy holidaymakers look for a Greek island in the Aegean.
explanation.definitionFit: Kos is one of the Dodecanese islands of Greece, lying in the Aegean Sea.

clue.text: Doddery old bachelors originally living in outskirts of Whitby

indicators.note: the clue word that signals this step
outskirts are the edges, so the first and last letters of the town are used

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for bachelor, doubled for the plural

indicators.note: originally means the first letter of the word living

explanation.surface: Unsteady elderly single men live on the edge of Whitby, a Yorkshire seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: The outskirts of Whitby, W and Y, enclose O, BB and L; the parse places them without an indicator because 'in' lies inside 'living in'.
explanation.definitionFit: Wobbly describes being unsteady on one's feet, just as doddery does for a frail person.

clue.text: Lothario, perhaps? More like Solomon crossing eastern state

indicators.note: crossing means the wiser word spans across, holding the state inside it

parts.note: Solomon was proverbially wise, so more like him is wiser
Oman is a state in the Middle East

explanation.surface: Is a seducer a wiser man, like Solomon with his many wives, travelling through the East?
explanation.definitionFit: Lothario, the rake of a Restoration play, is the byword for a seducer of women; 'perhaps' marks the example.

clue.text: Instrument produced by graduates thus performing

parts.note: BAs, Bachelors of Arts, are graduates
so means thus, in this way
on means performing, as an actor on stage

explanation.surface: Music played by university graduates in the course of a performance.
explanation.definitionFit: The bassoon is a low-pitched woodwind instrument of the orchestra.

clue.text: City came first, securing last of five goals ultimately

indicators.note: securing means the word for came first holds the next letter inside

parts.note: led means came first, was in front

indicators.note: last of means only the final letter of the word five
ultimately means the final letter of the word goals

explanation.surface: A football match report: the city team led and sealed it with a fifth goal.
explanation.walkthrough: Leeds is a large city in Yorkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Leeds is a major English city, so it is an instance of a city.

clue.text: Greek mountain's huge appeal

definitions.note: read as 'Greek mountain is', the 's serving as the link

parts.note: OS, outsize, is the clothing abbreviation for huge
SA is short for sex appeal

explanation.surface: A Greek peak has enormous attraction for visitors.
explanation.walkthrough: OS (outsize) is a clothes-size label; SA is sex appeal.
explanation.definitionFit: Ossa is a mountain in Thessaly, famous in myth for the giants piling Pelion upon it.

clue.text: Makes start, sadly, as scourge of workforce?

indicators.note: sadly means things have gone badly, so these letters are muddled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone sadly begins work, as a hated boss of the staff might.
explanation.definitionFit: A taskmaster is a strict overseer who drives workers hard, a bane of any workforce; the question mark marks the playful description.

clue.text: Wavering of ambassador initially inept in post

parts.note: HE, His Excellency, is the title of an ambassador

indicators.note: in means the letter is placed inside the word for post

parts.note: a station is a post, a place of duty

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the word inept

explanation.surface: An incompetent ambassador dithers at his diplomatic posting.
explanation.definitionFit: Hesitation is indecision, a pause from uncertainty, which is what wavering means as a noun.

clue.text: Fashionable cosmetic preparation for one vocalising in church

parts.note: in means fashionable, popular
toner is a skin lotion used in cosmetics

explanation.surface: A trendy beauty product is being promoted for church singers.
explanation.definitionFit: An intoner chants or recites in a level voice, as a priest does with prayers in a service.

clue.text: Report of sludge in one of three rivers

indicators.note: report means what is spoken, so the word is the one heard, not written

parts.note: ooze is soft mud or sludge

explanation.surface: News of mud found in one of several waterways.
explanation.definitionFit: England has more than one River Ouse, notably the Great Ouse, the Yorkshire Ouse and the Sussex Ouse.

clue.text: Ignorant, but not tight, do we hear?

indicators.note: a question about hearing means the letters come from how words sound when spoken

parts.note: untaut, not taut, means not tight

explanation.surface: Someone is uninformed but sober, or so we're told.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tight' tempts as drunk, but here it is the opposite of slack.
explanation.definitionFit: Untaught means without education, lacking knowledge, which is to be ignorant.

clue.text: Spooky entertainer left president following golf

indicators.note: following means the later pieces come after the letter for golf

parts.note: G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a host entertains guests
Ike was the nickname of US President Eisenhower

explanation.surface: A creepy party host walked out on the president after a round of golf.
explanation.definitionFit: Ghostlike means resembling a ghost, eerie, which is what spooky means.

clue.text: Most balanced article written in small refuge

indicators.note: written in means the article is set inside the other letters

parts.note: a nest is a snug retreat or refuge
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: The sanest piece of writing appears in a tiny shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanest means most sound in mind, most level-headed, as a balanced person is.

clue.text: Finally he hangs out somehow in Japanese governor's office

indicators.note: somehow means in some unspecified way, so the letters are rearranged
finally means the last letter of the word he

explanation.surface: In the end, he loafs about in a Japanese official's office.
explanation.definitionFit: A shogunate was the office or rule of a shogun, Japan's military governor.

clue.text: Italian poet's heartless noble

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letter of the poet's name is removed

parts.note: Ariosto, author of Orlando Furioso, was an Italian poet; the 's reads as 'is'

explanation.surface: An Italian poet is a cold-hearted aristocrat.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'poet's' stands for 'is', joining the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Aristo is informal for aristocrat, a member of the nobility.

clue.text: Scorer's stock stories about start of match

definitions.note: read as 'Scorer is'; a scorer here is a composer, one who writes scores

indicators.note: about means the stock and stories go round the letter

parts.note: set and stock both mean standard or stereotyped, as in a set or stock phrase

indicators.note: start of means the first letter of the word match

parts.note: ana is a collection of anecdotes or stories

explanation.surface: A cricket scorer's usual tales concern the start of the game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scorer' looks like a cricket or football official; it is a composer. The M goes inside SET after its S.
explanation.definitionFit: Bedřich Smetana, the Czech composer of Má Vlast, wrote musical scores.

clue.text: Storyteller from Scottish island returning to centre of Kinross

indicators.note: returning means the island's name is read backwards

parts.note: Arran is an island in the Firth of Clyde, Scotland

indicators.note: centre of means the middle letter of the word Kinross

explanation.surface: A storyteller travels back from a Scottish island to the middle of Kinross, a Scottish town.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrator is the one who recounts a story, a storyteller.

clue.text: Remorseful American hiding in an outhouse

parts.note: a and an are the same indefinite article

indicators.note: hiding in means the American is concealed inside the other letters

parts.note: a shed is an outhouse

explanation.surface: A guilty American hides away in a garden shed.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashamed means feeling guilt or shame, which is to be remorseful.

clue.text: Fish deft anglers catch easily to begin with

indicators.note: to begin with means the first letters of each of these words are taken

explanation.surface: Skilled anglers land a fish with no trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: The dace is a small freshwater fish of the carp family.

clue.text: Join a former partner collecting news

indicators.note: collecting means the other letters gather the news inside them

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
N is the abbreviation for new, so news is taken as two of them

explanation.surface: Get together with a former spouse who gathers the latest gossip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'news' is read as the plural of N, the abbreviation for new, so it supplies two Ns.
explanation.definitionFit: To annex is to attach or add on, especially territory, so it means to join.

clue.text: Half of them sketch vaguely from beginning to end

indicators.note: half of means the first two of the four letters of them

parts.note: to rough out is to sketch in outline without detail

explanation.surface: Half of them draw loosely the whole time.
explanation.definitionFit: Throughout means all the way through, from start to finish.

clue.text: Speak indistinctly, losing marks at first, say

indicators.note: losing means a letter is taken away from the word for speaking indistinctly

parts.note: to mutter is to speak indistinctly

indicators.note: at first means the first letter of the word marks

explanation.surface: Mumbling, then dropping points early on, is one way to talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' at the end looks like 'for example', but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To utter is to speak or voice words, which is to say them.

clue.text: Resident in Hampshire briefly entertaining a little

indicators.note: entertaining means the shortened county holds the other letters inside it
briefly means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: Hants is the abbreviation for Hampshire, a county in southern England
a bit means a little

explanation.surface: Someone living in Hampshire briefly hosts something small.
explanation.walkthrough: Hampshire, a county of southern England, is regularly shortened to Hants on addresses.
explanation.definitionFit: An inhabitant is someone who lives in a place, a resident.

clue.text: A second son, one behaving foolishly

explanation.surface: A younger son is the family fool.
explanation.definitionFit: An ass is a stupid person, someone acting like a fool.

clue.text: Fellow keeping oxen at first for beef

indicators.note: keeping means the fellow holds the letter inside him

parts.note: a man is a fellow

indicators.note: at first means the first letter of the word oxen

explanation.surface: A farmer keeps cattle to raise for beef.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beef' is the verb, to complain, not meat from oxen.
explanation.definitionFit: To beef is slang for to grumble or complain, which is to moan.

clue.text: Discharge former partner in robust health

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
hale means healthy and robust

explanation.surface: A patient is discharged with an ex who is in fine fettle.
explanation.definitionFit: To exhale is to breathe out, to discharge air from the lungs.

clue.text: Quiet, more colourful piece of office equipment

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
redder means more red, more vividly coloured

explanation.surface: A quieter but brighter item for the office.
explanation.definitionFit: A shredder cuts documents into strips and is a standard office machine.
